answer: Admission is a bonded warehouse license: a verifier called BondGate resolves the license at the port authority and the surety bond at the underwriter, refusing any bond or license already tied to a seat. The penalty trigger is a duplicate bond number or a surety cancellation filed mid epoch, which burns both bonds and suspends the license. Bond premium six hundred dollars, license two thousand, annual audit four hundred, so N fakes cost N times three thousand dollars plus N audit days. No thread of paper authority repeats, the vault holds one seal per seat, and no ledge hides a second.
